description: D9: the fact-checker verifies findings independently of the research phase. A fact-checker task, or a case passage appended to it, that names any of these is refused (the Pi launcher, harness/pi/src/roles.ts) or left out (case search, integrations/case_search.py). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions valid in both JavaScript and Python; matched against text with backslashes turned into forward slashes. The fact-checker's file tools hide the same material through denyReads in harness/composition.json.
